transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, October 17. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'A relief that it was over': China No. 1 Wei Yi on 'long break' after Candidates. In an exclusive interaction with TimesofIndia.com, China's No. 1 Wei Yi opens up about the exhaustion of competing in his maiden Candidates Tournament, describing the end of the gruelling 14-round event as a relief. The Grandmaster reflects on his performance in Cyprus, the pressures of elite chess, why players sometimes need extended breaks to recover, and more. Bill Gates' daughters join mother to sign as founding backers of $100 million fund. Melinda French Gates, alongside her daughters, has joined a groundbreaking philanthropic venture designed to enhance women's health globally. The Women's Health Co-Lab aims to generate $100 million, supporting diverse organizations over three years. Phoebe Gates highlights the ongoing challenges women encounter in health and safety. With over $70 million already pledged by prominent philanthropists, the initiative is actively seeking more funding to meet its goal and broaden its reach. Pennsylvania woman's $250,000 family farm sale remains blocked after sibling dispute. Siblings are embroiled in a legal conflict over the fate of their family-owned 60-acre farm in Pennsylvania. A sister residing on the land sought to sell it despite having a long-term tenancy. In response, her siblings filed an urgent petition to block the sale, citing property rights. The Pennsylvania Superior Court supported the injunction, illustrating the complicated nature of co-ownership and informal familial arrangements in property disputes. Dipke held under preventive detention, to be produced before SEM court; Neha Bora released. Delhi Police on Saturday said that Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and All India Students' Association (AISA) president Neha Bora were detained under preventive provisions on the evening of October 16. What about our livelihood, ask Delhi traders as protests disrupt festive sales. On Friday afternoon, Connaught Place once again witnessed thin footfall despite a festive season being underway. Jailer 2 Day 2: Rajinikanth's film crosses rupees 200 cr worldwide. Rajinikanth's much-anticipated action flick, 'Jailer 2', starring Mohanlal and Vidya Balan, garnered massive success at the box office, raking in over rupees 200 crore within just 48 hours of its release. The film enjoyed robust performances both domestically and internationally, particularly in its Tamil version. Although there was a slight dip in earnings on the second day, audience turnout remained vibrant. Critics and viewers have delivered mixed reviews overall. 'UP police acting as law unto themselves': Allahabad HC slams cops over detention. The Allahabad high court has pulled up the Uttar Pradesh Police over the unlawful detention of a man before his formal arrest, observing that the police appear to be acting as a "law unto themselves". Edinburgh's 1834 Palm House reopens after £23.5m restoration. The Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh's Palm Houses have undergone extensive restorations costing £23.5 million over the past five years. Researchers carefully replaced all 5,750 glass panes to ensure they withstand harsh weather conditions. Following this work, nearly 600 rare plant specimens have been replanted in the glasshouses. The restoration enables continued conservation, education, and scientific discovery efforts related to endangered flora. California land trust sues to block roads across a 402-acre preserve. In a bid to protect the Clover Valley nature preserve, Placer Land Trust has initiated a lawsuit to block infrastructure development attempts. Established four years ago, this cherished area has faced housing pressures in the past. It comprises ancient oak forests, wetlands, and vital archaeological sites. The conservation easement was created to enforce permanent protection, and the legal proceedings will reinforce this against any existing development rights. Trump fires Katie Zacharia as press secretary after 5 days; sets shortest-tenure record. US President Donald Trump's latest White House shake-up has set a new record, with press secretary Katie Zacharia shown the door just five days after taking up the job, according to officials cited by CNN. Court tells US to process Green Card applications for up to 55k people. A federal judge has ordered the reopening of the diversity visa lottery for 2027, allowing 55,000 applicants. The ruling came after a lawsuit filed against Secretary of State Marco Rubio regarding the lottery's registration. Judge Jinsook Ohta mandated a 30-day registration period for submissions, which must meet eligibility requirements. Additionally, new policy changes require some applicants to return to their home countries for Green Card processing.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Madhya Pradesh Power Crisis Deepens As Demand Touches 17,000 MW, State Banks On Northeast Monsoon To Ease Rural Power Cuts. Madhya Pradesh hopes the northeast monsoon, expected around October 20, will ease its electricity shortage by reducing demand in southern states. Madhya Pradesh Police Headquarters has initiated the promotion process for 205 inspectors previously excluded from the September DSP promotion exercise. From Better Half To Biggest Fear! Bhopal Men Seek Divorce Citing Safety Concerns; Counsellors Report 30 Cases Every Month. OBC Mahasabha and other backward class organisations met Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, demanding stronger legal arguments for 27 percent reservation in the Supreme Court. Madhya Pradesh's Excise Department is preparing to initiate an FIR against suspended officer Deepam Raichura over alleged irregularities in liquor contracts. Under Swamitva Yojana, Indore district administration is preparing land title deeds for 2,148 beneficiaries, with 167 documents already completed. Apex court stays Bhopal trial in Twisha death case India News. Indore Raja Raghuvanshi Murder Case! Mother Demands Death Penalty For Sonam, Five Others; Cites Meerut Murder Verdict. Uma Raghuvanshi, mother of Raja Raghuvanshi, has demanded the death penalty for Sonam Raghuvanshi and five other accused in the Meghalaya honeymoon murder case. Plague fears in Russia put troupe's Bhopal Ramleela performance on hold. 12-year-old Bhopal tribal girl found murdered in house ruins; man detained. What the survivors of Bhopal can teach the world. Ujjain Schoolboys' Secret Goa Trip Ends At Maksi Railway Station, Police Trace Trio On Train. Three Class VIII students from Gyan Sagar School in Ujjain secretly left school to visit Goa after watching social media reels. Indore Lokayukta Raid Update! 38 Properties Worth rupees 35.46 Crore Linked To Head Constable Firoz Khan, Four More Assets Identified. Indore Lokayukta investigators have identified four additional properties linked to head constable Firoz Khan, raising the total to 38 immovable assets with an estimated market value of rupees 35.46 crore.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Voluntary Provident Fund: Should you invest beyond EPF? Interest rates, tax rules and the rupees 2.5 lakh limit explained. VPF allows salaried employees to invest beyond mandatory EPF contributions at the prevailing 8.25 percent interest rate. Understand the rupees 2.5 lakh tax-free interest limit, tax on excess contributions and withdrawal rules before investing more for retirement. Tata, HDFC, ICICI Prudential mutual funds halt fresh gold FoF investments: What it means for existing and new investors. Leading mutual fund houses such as Tata Mutual Fund and HDFC Mutual Fund have suspended fresh investments in their gold fund-of-funds. The halt comes as a response to macroeconomic factors affecting gold imports and the value of the rupee. Existing investments in these funds remain unaffected, allowing ongoing systematic plans to continue. New investors now have alternative options for gold exposure, including direct investments in Gold ETFs. Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund September portfolio: 35 stocks, including Groww and NTPC, see higher holdings. Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund raised its holdings in Groww, NTPC and HDFC Bank in September, added Zydus Lifesciences and exited Cyient DLM. It also trimmed positions in Divi's Laboratories and Oracle Financial Services Software. EPFO WhatsApp channel: Can you access EPF, EPS and EDLI services? How to join. EPFO has introduced a new WhatsApp channel to keep subscribers informed about its schemes and services, attracting around two lakh users so far. The channel provides insights into the Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' Pension Scheme, and Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance. A 30 percent salary hike or bedtime with his toddler? Parent's career dilemma sparks debate over the real cost of switching job. A 30 percent salary hike may look attractive, but tax, commuting and childcare costs can shrink the gain. An illustrative rupees 18 lakh salary scenario shows how a rupees 5.4 lakh raise could leave just rupees 1.74 lakh in extra annual money. NRI capital gains tax: When can you use the basic exemption limit to lower your income tax bill?. For non-resident Indians, leveraging the basic exemption limit can help mitigate normal slab rate taxes on capital gains. However, it's important to note that this exemption does not apply to capital gains taxed at special rates, such as short-term capital gains derived from listed bonds. This stipulation is clearly defined in the Income Tax law, and tax treaties may additionally offer advantages depending on the NRI's country of residence. Government issues notification on PM CARES scholarship, spells out rules for children without Aadhaar. The government has notified Aadhaar verification rules for PM CARES for Children scholarship beneficiaries. Children cannot be denied benefits solely because authentication fails or they lack Aadhaar, subject to prescribed alternative identity-verification procedures. Ray Dalio's All Weather portfolio versus 60:40 portfolio: Which delivered better returns over 15 years in India?. Ray Dalio's All Weather portfolio returned 9.9 percent annually over 15 years in India, compared with 10.4 percent for a 60:40 portfolio and 12 percent for the Nifty 500 TRI. However, it had lower volatility and a smaller peak-to-trough fall, highlighting the trade-off between returns and risk. SBI increases home loan rates: How your rupees 30 lakh to rupees 1 crore home loan EMIs can be impacted; see calculations. In response to a recent 25 bps hike, the State Bank of India has updated its home loan interest rates. Those linked to the External Benchmark Linked Rate will need to revise their equated monthly installments. Borrowers can mitigate the impact through options like adjusting EMIs or extending the loan period. Missed a gold loan EMI? Know when your pledged jewellery is at risk , Experts explain recovery process and auction rules. Missed a gold loan EMI? An overdue payment does not automatically mean your pledged jewellery will be auctioned. Understand the RBI framework, how lenders handle defaults, the notice process, and what borrowers can do to reclaim their gold before it is sold. India's IPO league table: How the largest listings opened. Jio Platforms is set to launch its IPO bidding on October 21, offering 27 crore shares without any offer for sale. The price band is set between rupees 1,065 and rupees 1,119 per share, targeting a total of rupees 30,213 crore. Following recent IPOs like Hyundai and LIC, which struggled below their original prices, market sentiment is now emphasizing profitability. Analysts will closely monitor Jio's listing amid this competitive landscape. Man earning rupees 3,500 a month faced rupees 1.46 crore tax demand; how ITAT Mumbai came to his rescue. ITAT Mumbai quashed a rupees 1.46 crore reassessment against a man who said he earned rupees 3,500 a month, ruling that the tax department failed to establish valid service of the notice. The tribunal did not decide whether the disputed transactions were genuine. Health insurance claim: 5 things to prepare before hospitalisation to avoid last-minute hassles. Prepare for a health insurance claim with 5 essential steps before hospitalisation. Check policy documents, identify network hospitals, organise medical records, understand coverage limits and maintain a claims folder to reduce paperwork hassles and better manage potential out-of-pocket expenses. Home loan borrower alert: SBI, PNB, Bank of India and other banks revise repo-linked lending rates. Following the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) repo rate hike, several banks have increased their Repo-linked Lending Rates (RLLR). ET Wealth Expo 2026: Explore the future of investing, financial security and intergenerational wealth. The MT ST 3 was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, while the YARA J was hit by a drone off Romania. Fortunately, all 24 Indian nationals aboard both vessels are reported safe and unharmed. India has condemned attacks on commercial vessels, citing concerns for the safety of seafarers.
